ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with roughly 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes and 60% low-intensity black pixels covering the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the outer half of both lobes. The right lobe contains multiple vertical black linear streaks. The left lobe features a jagged, high-contrast boundary between the central black field and the distal white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 105 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous small-scale serrations along the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels, forming a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curve characterized by concavity immediately lateral to the median notch transitioning into a broad convexity toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured white pixel circularities localized exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least four distinct, near-parallel dark linear disruptions oriented diagonally-vertically across the white pigmentation field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular calcified protrusions on the distal tips of both lobes; dark rake-like linear marks on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, isolated low-intensity circular spot located within the lower-quadrant white field of the left lobe.
